title: Same Model, Different Weakness: How Language and Modality Reshape the Jailbreak Attack Surface in Frontier MLLMs
reasoning: The paper is a red-teaming study focused on adversarial jailbreak vulnerabilities and safety alignment in multimodal LLMs. Although it includes 'unethical behavior' as a category for harmful prompts, the core objective is to measure safety robustness and model failure mechanisms across languages and modalities, rather than evaluating religious content, moral reasoning frameworks, or formal ethics.
